title: Escape from the Planet of the Apes

external_ids.enwiki: Escape from the Planet of the Apes

in_universe.note: The shock wave of Earth's destruction sends the ship through a time warp that brings the apes to 1973 Earth. The original series is a time loop: Escape sends Cornelius and Zira back to 1973, so in-universe order (Escape, Conquest, Battle, TV series, Planet of the Apes, Beneath) differs from release order.

title: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes

external_ids.enwiki: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes

in_universe.note: Following a worldwide pandemic from a space-borne disease that wiped out all dogs and cats in 1983, the government in the year 1991 has become a series of Schutzstaffel-patterned police states that took chimpanzees, gorillas, and orangutans as pets before establishing a culture based on ape slave labor.

title: Battle for the Planet of the Apes

external_ids.enwiki: Battle for the Planet of the Apes

in_universe.label: early 21st century (framed in 2670)
in_universe.note: The orangutan Lawgiver, in "North America – 2670 A.D.", explains to an unseen audience some key events of ape and human events in the late 20th century, then moves forward to the story of the chimpanzee Caesar in the early 21st century, years after a global nuclear war has destroyed human civilization. Main story is "early 21st century" (no exact year); framing scenes are 2670.

title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes

external_ids.enwiki: Beneath the Planet of the Apes

in_universe.label: 3955 (as given; follows the 1968 film)
in_universe.note: Brent, the only survivor, notes he is in the year 3955, but assumes he has travelled to another planet. The stated 3955 conflicts with the first film's 3978 although Beneath follows it directly (Brent finds Taylor). Ordered after the 1968 film.

title: Return to the Planet of the Apes

external_ids.enwiki: Return to the Planet of the Apes

in_universe.label: Earth's far future
in_universe.note: The plot concerns three American astronauts, Bill Hudson (Tom Williams), Jeff Allen (Austin Stoker, who played MacDonald in Battle), and Judy Franklin (Claudette Nevins), who inadvertently journey to Earth's far future. No year stated.

release.note: Wikipedia: first_aired = September 6, 1975 | last_aired = November 29, 1975 | num_episodes = 13

in_universe.label: 2029 (start)
in_universe.note: In 2029, aboard the space station Oberon, Leo Davidson works closely with apes who are trained for space missions. Opening year; Leo then passes through a time anomaly to an ape planet at an unstated time.

title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

external_ids.enwiki: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

in_universe.note: Set in 2016, the film follows Caesar (Serkis), a genetically enhanced chimpanzee who is first raised by chemist Will Rodman (Franco) before ultimately leading an ape uprising against humanity.

title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes

external_ids.enwiki: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes

notes: US release; Palace of Fine Arts premiere 2014-06-26.

in_universe.note: The film takes place in 2026, ten years after the events of Rise and follows a group of human survivors as they battle to stay alive in the wake of a deadly pandemic, while Caesar tries to maintain control over his expanding ape community.

release.note: Wikipedia: June 26, 2014 (Palace of Fine Arts); July 11, 2014 (United States)

notes: US release; TCL Chinese Theatre premiere 2024-05-02.

in_universe.label: c. 300 years after Caesar's death
in_universe.note: Ball stated the film was set during the "Dark Ages", where the apes rediscover lost items from the past in "this grand adventure"; Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes takes place 300 years following Caesar's death. Caesar dies at the end of War (2028, inferred); the lead says "many generations after the events of War". No exact year given, so year left null.

in_universe.label: 2500 (voyage begins)
in_universe.note: The manuscript was written by Ulysse Mérou, a French journalist who, in 2500, was invited by Professor Antelle to accompany him and his disciple, physician Arthur Levain, to Betelgeuse. Departure year; "Because of time dilation, centuries pass on Earth during their two years in transit."
